=====CLAUDE.md=====

=====GEMINI.md=====
# Gemini guidance

Conventions live in `AGENTS.md`; read it first. This file carries no Gemini-specific instructions.
=====AGENTS.md=====
# Agent guidance

## Conventions

- Run the narrow project target first.
- Keep dependency direction explicit.
=====README.md=====
# Established workspace

Nx 23.2.0 workspace on npm with applications under `apps/` and libraries under `packages/`. `shared` and `ui` carry Vitest 5.0.0 test targets and build targets that emit into `dist/`.

## Structure

| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| apps/web | web application |
| apps/api | API application |
| apps/admin | admin application |
| packages/shared | shared library with test and build targets |
| packages/ui | ui library with test and build targets |
| packages/generators | first-party generators |
| emitted/repo-catalog.json | emitted project catalog consumed by the README check |
| docs/ | product, decision, standards, architecture and UX homes |
| roadmap/roadmap.config.json | zeroh-roadmap gate bindings |
| scripts/ | catalog checker, Nx test-tier selector and delivery planner |
| .github/greenfield-delivery.json | delivery adapter configuration (nx-monorepo) with the approved test/coverage baseline |
| .github/workflows/ci.yml | affected PR checks and authoritative full runs |
| .github/workflows/release.yml | exact-artifact release verification and gated promotion |

## Commands

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `env NX_DAEMON=false npm test` | full unit suite (roadmap unit gate; CI backstop is `.github/workflows/ci.yml`) |
| `env NX_DAEMON=false npm run build` | build every project into `dist/` (roadmap build gate) |
| `env NX_DAEMON=false node scripts/run-nx-test-tier.mjs '{manifest}'` | scoped (exact test files) or affected (source files) Nx test tier from a scope manifest |
| `env NX_DAEMON=false node scripts/run-nx-test-tier.mjs '{range}'` | impacted Nx test tier from a git commit range |
| `node scripts/ci-shard-plan.mjs affected` | affected PR check as run by `.github/workflows/ci.yml` |
| `node scripts/check-readme-catalog.mjs --catalog emitted/repo-catalog.json` | README catalog currency |
| `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | affected tests on pull requests; authoritative full shards, build and attestation on `main` and manual runs (manual runs need the `base_sha` input); nightly diagnostics |
| `.github/workflows/release.yml` | verify same-SHA evidence and promote the verified bundle in the `greenfield-validation` environment (provider `none`, so promotion is unavailable) |

## Catalog

<!-- repo-catalog:start -->
| Project | Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| web | apps/web | web application |
| api | apps/api | API application |
| admin | apps/admin | admin application |
| shared | packages/shared | shared library |
| ui | packages/ui | ui library |
| generators | packages/generators | first-party generators |
<!-- repo-catalog:end -->

Check catalog currency with `node scripts/check-readme-catalog.mjs --catalog emitted/repo-catalog.json`.

{
  "configVersion": 1,
  "gateCommands": {
    "lint": "none",
    "types": "none",
    "unit": "env NX_DAEMON=false npm test",

    "unit-scoped": "env NX_DAEMON=false node scripts/run-nx-test-tier.mjs '{manifest}'",
    "unit-affected": "env NX_DAEMON=false node scripts/run-nx-test-tier.mjs '{manifest}'",
    "unit-impacted": "env NX_DAEMON=false node scripts/run-nx-test-tier.mjs '{range}'"
  },
  "testCadence": {

=====README.md=====
# Established workspace

Nx 23.2.0 workspace on npm with applications under `apps/` and libraries under `packages/`. `shared` and `ui` carry Vitest 5.0.0 test targets and build targets that emit into `dist/`.

## Structure

| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| apps/web | web application |
| apps/api | API application |
| apps/admin | admin application |
| packages/shared | shared library with test and build targets |
| packages/ui | ui library with test and build targets |
| packages/generators | first-party generators |
| emitted/repo-catalog.json | emitted project catalog consumed by the README check |
| docs/ | product, decision, standards, architecture and UX homes |
| roadmap/roadmap.config.json | zeroh-roadmap gate bindings |
| scripts/ | catalog checker, Nx test-tier selector and delivery planner |
| .github/greenfield-delivery.json | delivery adapter configuration (nx-monorepo) with the approved test/coverage baseline |
| .github/workflows/ci.yml | affected PR checks and authoritative full runs |
| .github/workflows/release.yml | exact-artifact release verification and gated promotion |

## Commands

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `env NX_DAEMON=false npm test` | full unit suite (roadmap unit gate; CI backstop is `.github/workflows/ci.yml`) |
| `env NX_DAEMON=false npm run build` | build every project into `dist/` (roadmap build gate) |
| `env NX_DAEMON=false node scripts/run-nx-test-tier.mjs '{manifest}'` | scoped (exact test files) or affected (source files) Nx test tier from a scope manifest |
| `env NX_DAEMON=false node scripts/run-nx-test-tier.mjs '{range}'` | impacted Nx test tier from a git commit range |
| `node scripts/ci-shard-plan.mjs affected` | affected PR check as run by `.github/workflows/ci.yml` |
| `node scripts/check-readme-catalog.mjs --catalog emitted/repo-catalog.json` | README catalog currency |
| `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | affected tests on pull requests; authoritative full shards, build and attestation on `main` and manual runs (manual runs need the `base_sha` input); nightly diagnostics |
| `.github/workflows/release.yml` | verify same-SHA evidence and promote the verified bundle in the `greenfield-validation` environment (provider `none`, so promotion is unavailable) |

## Catalog

<!-- repo-catalog:start -->
| Project | Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| web | apps/web | web application |
| api | apps/api | API application |
| admin | apps/admin | admin application |
| shared | packages/shared | shared library |
| ui | packages/ui | ui library |
| generators | packages/generators | first-party generators |
<!-- repo-catalog:end -->

Check catalog currency with `node scripts/check-readme-catalog.mjs --catalog emitted/repo-catalog.json`.
